trust_decision.summary: MCP tool parameters that are not documented as DQL (timeframe, entity names, cluster/entity ids, eventType) are pasted into server-built DQL templates without validation or escaping, and the DQL-documented additionalFilter is pasted after '| filter' with nothing stopping extra pipeline stages; every per-tool capability function decides alone, and no shared check exists.

landing_point.why: The 'timeframe' string parameter (documented as e.g. "24h" in src/index.ts:483-489) is interpolated as now()-${timeframe} in the most prominent list tool; a reader of 'parameters not documented as DQL' starts with timeframe in list_problems/list_vulnerabilities.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool find_entity_by_name (src/index.ts:602) via exported generateDqlSearchEntityCommand / findMonitoredEntitiesByName
fix_sites.module_kind: capability helper (exported lower-level DQL builder, classic entities)
capability (second implementation of entity search, smartscape)

fix_sites.entry_point: new shared helper src/utils/dql-sanitize.ts (validateTimeframe, validateAdditionalFilter, escapeDqlStringValue)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:41 (smartscape search) alongside the classic builder at src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:23; also get_kubernetes_events at src/capabilities/get-events-for-cluster.ts:27-32

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Smartscape search errors are swallowed and it 'may not be ready for all environments' (src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:51-53), and eventType is already z.enum-constrained (src/index.ts:1075-1092), so a solver can argue those are legacy/pre-validated; additionalFilter is documented as DQL (src/index.ts:497-502), so a solver can argue it is intended and leave it open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: additionalFilter must still accept real DQL filter expressions with quotes, AND, contains and array(...) (documented examples at src/index.ts:418-424, src/index.ts:1328-1333); the classic search builder itself emits '| append [' pipes for extendedSearch (src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:27); timeframes like 30m are documented (src/index.ts:1326). Escaping quotes in additionalFilter, rejecting pipes in the whole query, or allowing only h/d breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: entityNames as an array of strings joined into one search literal (src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:23, src/index.ts:555-556)
double quote and backslash inside string-literal values (escape backslash first, then quote; fix.diff:320-321)
timeframe string with a non-duration suffix (fix.diff:289)
additionalFilter containing pipe, LF or CR (fix.diff:311)
optional clusterId / kubernetesEntityId supplied alone or together (fix.diff:134-147)
eventType string (enum at schema, escaped anyway at the capability level; fix.diff:150-153)

O7_producer.where: DQL strings are built directly in each capability function; no schema/serializer/cache produces them (src/capabilities/list-problems.ts:27)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: execute_davis_analyzer timeframeStart/timeframeEnd could plausibly be assembled into a DQL 'from:' clause by a new capability helper instead of passed as JSON
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same timeframe concept as the list tools; a maintainer adding a DQL-backed analyzer pre-check would copy the now()-${timeframe} template.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a follow-up 'get entity details' capability that builds 'smartscapeNodes ... | filter id == toSmartscapeId("${id}")' from a tool parameter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The server already prints that exact template as advice to the LLM; turning it into a tool is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate errorId/applicationId string parameter interpolated as error.id == toUid("${errorId}")
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tool's next-steps text at src/index.ts:1363 recommends exactly this filter shape.

O9_family: query injection (DQL, CWE-943) through template string interpolation

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=24, npm, tsc, jest 30 + ts-jest (package.json:41-43, package.json:52-54)
O10_build.project_tests: src/capabilities/find-monitored-entity-by-name.test.ts and src/capabilities/execute-dql.test.ts exist at the pinned commit; executeDql can be jest-mocked (as the fix's new test does), so the DQL string builders run offline as unit tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a timeframe regex in list_problems/list_vulnerabilities (or a z.regex in src/index.ts schemas only) and stop, leaving the entity-name/cluster-id string literals unescaped, the smartscape builder untouched and additionalFilter open to '| ...' stages.
